reason: Build the room around the large foreground work island and the two tall wooden cabinet groups visible behind it.
observation: The honey-colored island top projects beyond a dark paneled base. A glass-front cabinet fills the back left, while a long cabinet with a recessed pale wall band fills the back right. Narrow wood floorboards and soft light complete the room.

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(7)

scene = Scene('Old woodworking room')
wall = (0.70, 0.79, 0.75)
trim = (0.25, 0.16, 0.10)
wood = (0.24, 0.145, 0.085)
woodlight = (0.29, 0.18, 0.105)
wooddark = (0.16, 0.095, 0.055)
panel = (0.21, 0.125, 0.075)
honey = (0.57, 0.39, 0.20)
glass = (0.48, 0.66, 0.65)
metal = (0.105, 0.095, 0.075)

# Architectural shell, open toward the camera.
room = Asset('Room architecture')
room.include('back pale plaster wall', box((9, .12, 4.3), center=(0, 3.20, 2.10), color=wall))
room.include('left wall sliver', box((.12, 7, 4.3), center=(-4.3, -.3, 2.10), color=wall))
room.include('back baseboard', box((8.6, .09, .20), center=(0, 3.10, .12), color=trim))
room.include('left baseboard', box((.09, 6.6, .20), center=(-4.22, -.2, .12), color=trim))
scene.include('architecture', room)

# Individually editable, narrow floorboards with staggered ends.
floor = Asset('Aged plank floor')
for i in range(30):
    x = -4.25 + i*.29
    y = -5.5 - (i % 3)*.53
    j = 0
    while y < 3.1:
        length = min(2.05 + random.uniform(-.25,.25), 3.15-y)
        if length <= .05: break
        c = random.uniform(-.035,.035)
        floor.include('floor plank %02d %02d' % (i,j), box((.285,length-.012,.045), center=(x,y+length/2,-.025), color=(.43+c,.30+c,.19+c)))
        y += length
        j += 1
scene.include('floorboards', floor)

# Central island: long axis goes away from the viewer.
island = Asset('Central work island')
island.include('thick honey oak worktop', fillet_box((2.55,3.55,.14), radius=.018, center=(0,-.42,1.00), color=honey))
island.include('dark cabinet carcass', box((1.95,2.95,.78), center=(0,-.40,.48), color=wood))
# Four exposed corner posts continue below the cabinet as short feet.
for x in (-.91,.91):
    for y in (-1.78,.98):
        island.include('corner leg %.2f %.2f' % (x,y), box((.13,.14,.88), center=(x,y,.44), color=woodlight))
# Broad paneled near end, seen below the overhang.
yfront = -1.91
island.include('near end recessed panel', box((1.66,.025,.57), center=(0,yfront,.48), color=panel))
for x in (-.84,.84):
    island.include('near end vertical frame %.2f' % x, box((.11,.07,.72), center=(x,yfront-.025,.48), color=woodlight))
for z in (.17,.79):
    island.include('near end horizontal rail %.2f' % z, box((1.75,.07,.10), center=(0,yfront-.025,z), color=woodlight))
# Storage on the left long side: framed doors and a bank of drawers.
xside = -1.0
for k, y in enumerate((-1.34,-.38,.58)):
    island.include('side inset door %d' % k, box((.025,.80,.47), center=(xside,y,.40), color=panel))
    for dy in (-.42,.42):
        island.include('side door stile %d %.2f' % (k,dy), box((.055,.075,.53), center=(xside-.015,y+dy,.40), color=woodlight))
    for z in (.15,.65):
        island.include('side door rail %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.055,.88,.065), center=(xside-.015,y,z), color=woodlight))
    island.include('side drawer %d' % k, box((.045,.84,.16), center=(xside-.012,y,.75), color=woodlight))
    island.include('drawer dark pull %d' % k, rod(.022, start=(xside-.055,y-.085,.75), end=(xside-.055,y+.085,.75), color=metal))
    island.include('door knob %d' % k, ball(.025, center=(xside-.06,y+.27,.43), color=metal))
    for z in (.24,.52):
        island.include('door hinge %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.018,.035,.13), center=(xside-.05,y-.39,z), color=(.47,.48,.43)))
scene.include('island', island)

# Left tall built-in cabinet. The glass doors extend beyond the top of the image.
left = Asset('Left glass front cabinet')
lx = -2.20
left.include('cabinet dark back', box((2.65,.53,3.40), center=(lx,2.84,1.70), color=wooddark))
left.include('lower body', box((2.65,.67,1.10), center=(lx,2.75,.57), color=wood))
left.include('lower toe plinth', box((2.74,.73,.13), center=(lx,2.74,.08), color=wooddark))
left.include('lower ledge', box((2.74,.72,.10), center=(lx,2.72,1.13), color=woodlight))
for k in range(4):
    x = lx - .97 + k*.65
    left.include('lower drawer %d' % k, box((.60,.045,.21), center=(x,2.395,1.00), color=woodlight))
    left.include('lower drawer pull %d' % k, rod(.016, start=(x-.075,2.36,1.00), end=(x+.075,2.36,1.00), color=metal))
    left.include('lower inset door %d' % k, box((.56,.045,.67), center=(x,2.39,.49), color=panel))
    for dx in (-.285,.285):
        left.include('lower door stile %d %.2f' % (k,dx), box((.055,.06,.72), center=(x+dx,2.36,.49), color=woodlight))
    for z in (.15,.83):
        left.include('lower door rail %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.60,.06,.06), center=(x,2.36,z), color=woodlight))
    left.include('lower door knob %d' % k, ball(.025, center=(x+.19,2.31,.51), color=metal))
# pale translucent glass panes and inner shelves
left.include('cabinet pale interior', box((2.45,.025,2.18), center=(lx,3.09,2.30), color=(.49,.62,.59)))
for z in (1.58,2.24,2.90):
    left.include('interior shelf %.2f' % z, box((2.43,.43,.035), center=(lx,2.82,z), color=woodlight))
for k in range(4):
    x = lx-.975+k*.65
    left.include('glass door pane %d' % k, box((.55,.025,2.12), center=(x,2.49,2.30), color=glass, opacity=.48))
    for dx in (-.30,.30):
        left.include('glass door stile %d %.2f' % (k,dx), box((.075,.09,2.30), center=(x+dx,2.43,2.30), color=woodlight))
    for z in (1.18,1.88,2.58,3.44):
        left.include('glass door rail %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.64,.09,.075), center=(x,2.43,z), color=woodlight))
    left.include('glass door pull %d' % k, rod(.012,start=(x+.23,2.37,1.60),end=(x+.23,2.37,1.75),color=metal))
scene.include('left tall cabinet', left)

# Right long built-in: lower cabinet, deep work surface, open wall strip and upper cupboard.
right = Asset('Right built in cabinet')
rx = 1.22
right.include('lower cabinet body', box((3.75,.69,1.13), center=(rx,2.76,.59), color=wood))
right.include('lower base molding', box((3.85,.76,.13), center=(rx,2.74,.10), color=wooddark))
right.include('deep brown counter', box((3.90,.82,.11), center=(rx,2.70,1.20), color=wooddark))
for k in range(5):
    x = rx-1.50+k*.75
    right.include('lower drawer %d' % k, box((.69,.05,.24), center=(x,2.39,.99), color=woodlight))
    right.include('lower drawer pull %d' % k, rod(.018,start=(x-.08,2.35,.99),end=(x+.08,2.35,.99),color=metal))
    right.include('lower door inset %d' % k, box((.66,.035,.68), center=(x,2.395,.51), color=panel))
    for dx in (-.33,.33):
        right.include('lower door frame %d %.2f' % (k,dx), box((.055,.06,.71), center=(x+dx,2.36,.51), color=woodlight))
    for z in (.18,.84):
        right.include('lower door rail %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.70,.06,.065), center=(x,2.36,z), color=woodlight))
# Back wall remains visible as the broad band between upper cabinets and countertop.
right.include('right full height end panel', box((.18,.76,3.45), center=(3.16,2.76,1.72), color=wood))
right.include('upper cupboard dark back', box((3.70,.45,1.43), center=(rx,2.91,2.85), color=wooddark))
right.include('upper cupboard bottom ledge', box((3.83,.58,.11), center=(rx,2.84,2.15), color=woodlight))
for k in range(5):
    x = rx-1.47+k*.735
    right.include('upper glass pane %d' % k, box((.63,.025,1.18), center=(x,2.65,2.84), color=glass, opacity=.52))
    for dx in (-.34,.34):
        right.include('upper door stile %d %.2f' % (k,dx), box((.075,.08,1.34), center=(x+dx,2.59,2.84), color=woodlight))
    for z in (2.19,3.48):
        right.include('upper door rail %d %.2f' % (k,z), box((.73,.08,.08), center=(x,2.59,z), color=woodlight))
    right.include('upper handle %d' % k, rod(.012,start=(x+.26,2.54,2.56),end=(x+.26,2.54,2.70),color=metal))
scene.include('right long cabinet', right)
scene.include('between cabinets upright', box((.13,.12,3.65), center=(-.70,3.04,1.82), color=woodlight))

realize(scene)
# Subtle procedural grain, shared by wood objects; direction runs with the long board axis.
for mat in list(bpy.data.materials):
    if not mat.use_nodes or not mat.node_tree: continue
    bs = mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    if not bs: continue
    rgba = tuple(bs.inputs['Base Color'].default_value)
    if rgba[0] > rgba[1]*1.12 and rgba[1] > rgba[2]*1.12 and rgba[0] > .12:
        nt = mat.node_tree
        tex = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
        tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 3.8
        tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 2.0
        tex.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = .7
        mapping = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
        mapping.operation = 'MULTIPLY'
        mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (5.0,.65,4.0)
        coord = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
        nt.links.new(coord.outputs['Generated'], mapping.inputs[0])
        nt.links.new(mapping.outputs[0], tex.inputs['Vector'])
        ramp = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .18
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (rgba[0]*.70,rgba[1]*.70,rgba[2]*.70,1)
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .82
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (min(rgba[0]*1.12,1),min(rgba[1]*1.12,1),min(rgba[2]*1.12,1),1)
        nt.links.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],ramp.inputs['Fac'])
        nt.links.new(ramp.outputs['Color'],bs.inputs['Base Color'])
        bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = .48

if bpy.context.scene.world is None:
    bpy.context.scene.world = bpy.data.worlds.new('Soft ambient world')
bpy.context.scene.world.use_nodes = True
bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value = (0.65,0.72,0.69,1)
bpy.context.scene.world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value = .38
